due_obligations.name: PUBLIC_RESEARCH_SCOUT
due_obligations.cadence: >=12h between runs and only if higher-priority work absent

due_obligations.name: SUCCESSOR_COMPOSITION
due_obligations.cadence: state-driven whenever admitted work is ready

selection_rule: Each Coordinator occurrence selects exactly one highest-priority eligible work unit or NO_CHANGE. All governed transitions use ProcessFactory/GardenProcess and engine required_gates().
blind_review_serialization: When multiple independent families are required, accumulate independent findings across later Coordinator occurrences rather than launching parallel scheduled/model work; advance BLIND_REVIEW_COMPLETE only when the required set is complete.
transient_failure_rule: 429/TOO_MANY_REQUESTS/concurrency/service-unavailable never advances GardenProcess state, never triggers immediate retry loops, and retains the same next_action for a later hourly occurrence after exact-state re-observation.
state_gating: Clock time only starts the Coordinator. CycleID, ProcessVersion, DesignEpoch, packet and contiguous GardenProcessTransitionReceipt/v1 evidence determine what may run.
algebra_rule: Every governed transition validates through REG-ALGEBRA-001. Scheduling/algebra conformance grants no authority and does not prove full semantic compliance.
